title: Riverton to Ban New Gasoline Car Sales by 2030
text: The city council of Riverton has voted to ban the sale of new gasoline-powered cars within city limits starting in 2030. Officials say the measure will cut air pollution and push residents toward electric vehicles. Critics argue the charging network is not ready and that low-income drivers will be hardest hit. The council promised subsidies for EV purchases and a rapid expansion of public charging stations over the next five years.
